title: Tight Bound for Nikiforov's Spectral Even-Cycle Conjecture
summary: Nikiforov conjectured that, for every fixed $k\ge2$ and all sufficiently large $n$, the unique $n$-vertex $C_{2k+2}$-free graph with maximum adjacency spectral radius is $S^+_{n,k}$, where $S_{n,k}=K_k\vee\overline K_{n-k}$ and $S^+_{n,k}$ is obtained from $S_{n,k}$ by adding one edge inside the independent part. Cioabă, Desai and Tait proved this conjecture for $n\ge k^{O(k)}$. Later, Li and Ning raised the problem of determining the optimal exponent $γ=γ(k)$ such that the same conclusion holds for $n\ge Ω(k^{γ(k)})$.
